subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve this bundled third-party action update across credentialed and release-sensitive workflows after the exact-head security and workflow checks complete?
rationale: The protected security label and breadth of privileged workflow consumers require an owner to accept the supply-chain update; automation can verify the upstream Codex compatibility fix but cannot choose the repository’s trust posture.

options.title: Approve after exact-head validation
options.body: Merge the single batch after the pending trusted workflow and security checks pass on the current head while preserving every full-SHA pin.

options.title: Split the sensitive actions
options.body: Separate the app-token, Docker, and Codex-action updates if maintainers want narrower audit and rollout units.

options.title: Hold the batch
options.body: Pause the update if an owner does not want to advance one of the privileged action suppliers in this group.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Merge the single batch after the pending trusted workflow and security checks pass on the current head while preserving every full-SHA pin.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most strongly to the guarded Codex-agent workflow that consumes a credentialed action.
